name: Ryoujoku Scout ~Idol Dokusen Keiyaku~
original_name: 凌辱スカウト〜アイドル独占契約〜
source:
Yukio is a talent scout, but it doesn't go well. To make a breakthrough, he comes up with an idea:

"How about making a girl my sex slave at first. I will be able to have sex with a beautiful girl and get promoted!"

He now decides to put his plan into motion...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
幸雄是一名星探，但事业始终没有起色。为了打破僵局，他想出了一个主意：

‘不如先把一个女孩变成自己的性奴隶。这样既能和美女发生性关系，也能得到晋升！’

现在，他决定将计划付诸行动……
